description: This file defines types and utility functions for handling legacy configuration rules, migrations, and related data structures. It includes functions for safe object management and parsing specific command structures for legacy configurations.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Returns the provided value as a Record<string, unknown> if it passes the isRecord type guard, otherwise null.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures that a specific key in the root object is assigned a record. If absent or not a record, creates a new record and assigns it.

methods.name: mergeMissing
methods.description: Merges properties from source into target, only if they are missing, skipping blocked keys and undefined values. Recursively merges nested records.

methods.name: mapLegacyAudioTranscription
methods.description: Transforms a value into a structured command object if it matches expected legacy transcription format, including safety checks and argument extraction.

methods.name: getAgentsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of agents from a provided agents record, defaulting to an empty array if not present or invalid.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentIdFromRaw
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID from raw config, following a priority order: explicit default, routing default, first available agent, or 'main'.

methods.name: ensureAgentEntry
methods.description: Ensures an agent with a specific ID exists in the list; if not, creates and pushes a new entry.

methods.name: defineLegacyConfigMigration
methods.description: A simple function returning the migration object, potentially used as a factory or placeholder.

ctags.pattern: /^export const ensureAgentEntry = (list: unknown[], id: string): Record<string, unknown> => {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export const getRecord = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null =>$/

ctags.pattern: /^export const mapLegacyAudioTranscription = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null => {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export const mergeMissing = (target: Record<string, unknown>, source: Record<string, unknown>) =/

ctags.pattern: /^  const result: Record<string, unknown> = { command: rawExecutable, type: "cli" };$/

ctags.pattern: /^  const result: Record<string, unknown> = { command: rawExecutable, type: "cli" };$/
